notes: KWARS1 GAMEPLAY HEALTH BUILD. Live soldier combat-state model (src/core/soldier-state.js): current equipment -> current role -> current formation, recomputed every step; a soldier who loses its spear immediately stops being a phalanx unit (weapon, role, attack range, spacing and formation slot all change, and it walks to a new melee slot). Four live formation bodies (PHALANX / DEFENSIVE_LINE / MELEE_LINE / SKIRMISH) derived from weapon + shield, assigned per band so the spear wall always holds the front. Slot stickiness removes formation churn (0.18% of unit-frames). Weapon-derived attack range including structures. Human-like locomotion: arrival easing, turn damping, role-weighted acceleration, facing deadband. PERFORMANCE: target acquisition rebuilt on sorted rosters (10.4x faster at 480 actors); formation gap-filling made linear (10x); per-frame allocation churn removed (worst frame 111ms -> 31ms, over-budget frames 6.2% -> 1.2%). ACTIVE SIMULATION BUDGET + REINFORCEMENT COHORTS: total wave size is unchanged and every enemy still enters the field; only simultaneous active actors are bounded (220 total), with reserves held as queue entries that run no AI, collision or targeting. Conservation (spawnedTotal + waveQueue === waveTotal) is exact and regression-tested. ENDLESS SAVE FIX: mid-wave saves no longer rewind the wave - living enemies return to the reserve queue and defeated enemies stay defeated, closing a gold exploit where backgrounding the app let already-killed enemies be farmed again. Wave rewards are idempotent; boss spawn/defeat state is tracked so a resume can neither duplicate nor skip a boss.
